scope: Joint ordered operand selection compared with additional fitting of the same parent independent pointers. Original Train family selection, fixed all-Train refits, own-state sequential Train gates and fixed original Dev; controlled research documents are not evidence of organizational effectiveness.

decision.reason: No fixed candidate improved original public Dev: strict TAT-QA parent 16/48, joint seeds 42/43/44 15/48,16/48,16/48. All research retention gates passed. Preserve fixed primary 42 and do not switch seeds, epochs or inference modes using Dev.

plan.scope: Joint ordered operands over own top-5 candidates vs further fitting of the original independent operand pointers. Same frozen ModernBERT, fusion, remaining heads and demand model. Add all 740 observed states from original generated Train episodes as construction retention examples. Public arithmetic Train cases keep their original scalar scores, including unsupported expressions.
plan.selection: Split source families within original Train before loss fitting. Choose each epoch by highest public arithmetic strict answer count among checkpoints that preserve parent research scalar and operand-source counts, then lower own training-family-balanced held NLL; include unchanged parent epoch0. Compare condition mean public counts across seeds; tie favors original pointers. Fixed primary seed42, require all selected-condition seeds to improve parent and preserve research counts before refitting.
plan.nextGate: Refit selected condition for the chosen fixed epochs on all these Train cases. Require actual sequential Train parameter/evidence/state/type and generated/retail loss retention before fixed original Dev evaluation. Full public Dev denominator and costs stay unchanged.
plan.adoption: Require original public Dev improvement with other public task scores preserved and actual research losses and manager requests no worse. Do not adopt based on cached features or internal Train scores. No protected Test or frozen new-source holdout inference.
plan.conditionSelection: Only conditions where every seed improves public arithmetic strict answers and preserves parent research scalar and source counts are eligible. Among eligible conditions choose the highest mean public strict count across all seeds; exact tie favors existing independent pointers. Primary seed42 fixed. No eligible condition means no refit.
plan.retentionScoreScope: Cached supported scalar targets and existing missing/conflict annotations. A field without either is left unscored rather than fabricated as missing. Actual whole parameter/evidence/state/request/ordering gates are still required after refit.
plan.lossBalance: Each training field occurs once per epoch. Weights give equal total contribution to public arithmetic and research fields; both arms use identical examples and permutations.

plan.selection: Fixed epochs selected within Train before all-Train refitting. No new epoch/seed selection from refit diagnostics or Dev. Actual sequential Train retention required before the original Dev comparison.

devDiagnosis.scope: Post hoc description of changed Dev outputs; never used for fitting or candidate selection.

plan.protocol: Fixed all-Train refits 42/43/44 and identical retained parent. Each constructs its own parameters and chooses its own actions; no shared constructed states. Frozen encoder outputs may be reused only for identical complete observed views, with direct-forward equality checks. Enumerate all 16 manager availability masks for every retail episode and aggregate exact probabilities at 0, 0.1, 0.2. Require every seed to preserve generated/retail total loss, parameter/state/type/evidence accuracy, false handoffs, unnecessary/resolved requests and no-dropout recovery/necessary requests/handoff rate. Then freeze these candidates for one original Dev comparison.
plan.devGate: Use all 258 original public Dev cases, 60 generated cases and 336 retail cases at all 16 response masks. Every fixed seed must improve strict TAT-QA answer accuracy, preserve other public retention metrics and pass the same sequential research retention gates. No fallback seed, epoch or inference mode selection on Dev. Main seed 42 fixed. Neither protected Test nor the frozen 27-source holdout is evaluated.
plan.apiCorrection: Extend fixed per-field manager response conditions from retail Dev to Train/Dev. Cal/Test and nonretail remain rejected. Initial v1 stopped on the first Train retail mask before candidate evaluation. No model tensor or inference arithmetic changed; frozen head-training source preserved separately.

limitations: Internal selection uses original Train source families already seen by the parent encoder; not independent generalization.
Strict public Dev includes all 48 TAT-QA cases with original scoring, including unsupported expressions, multi-span/count, scaling and rounding failures.
Original Dev has been used for development; no new blind-test claim.
Exact retail Dev losses cover only five complete periods from four sources (35 controlled conditions); all 336 cases remain in parameter/request diagnostics.
Pair selection cannot repair wrong operations or retrieve values absent from its observed candidate pool.
Demand GRU and economic value heads were not retrained; no extra learned-value or calibration improvement is established.
Original protected Test result 243.6273603928693 remains attached to the old model; no new Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
Head learning requires the registered Train inputs and parent model. Public archives exclude the large derived encoder feature cache; inference reconstruction uses published weights and head files.
